resources.string: Choose audio source

Remember a preferred source for the next playback resolution. Current playback continues. Sources may require login or membership or have regional restrictions; confirming grants no additional playback rights.

Find candidates in local files, QQ Music, Kuwo, Bilibili, signed-in NetEase and enabled YouTube Music. Eligible recordings with verified audio addresses rank first. Conflicting versions, artists or durations prevent automatic selection. GD Studio remains a manual choice.
YouTube Music is disabled, so no search requests are sent to it. Existing choices can be cleared or rejected.
